scientific_limitations: The formula treats homogeneous endomorphism slices with one common generator-image length; it does not classify the full infinite endomorphism semigroup.
The checker covers only ranks at most three and lengths at most two and is supplementary to the symbolic proof.
An equivalent formulation in older transformation-semigroup or free-g-dimonoid literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Cycle-index formula for homogeneous endomorphisms of free g-dimonoids
